This is the best plan I found by comparing route options by hand. I didn't run a solver, so it isn't formally proven to be the lowest possible cost.

**Key decisions**
- **Blocked roads:** Benighat to Myagang, Myagang to Belkot, Jwalamukhi to Tarkeshwar and Likhu to Dupcheshwar are all closed, so routes go around them.
- **Belkot school:** It isn't a designated evacuation point, so the three shopkeepers there must be taken to Benighat.
- **car2 stays at Kalika hospital:** Using it to collect the bus driver at Likhu costs 26 minutes, compared with a 20-point penalty for deferring him. Routing it through Jwalamukhi to Benighat costs 38 minutes and still leaves one person behind, so it doesn't help either.
- **Far farms:** One 90-minute trip brings in all three elderly people from Kakani and Galchhi, plus one Kakani labourer. A second trip for the remaining three adults would cost far more than their 60 points in penalties.

**car1 trips (all start and end at Benighat)**

| Trip | People rescued | Minutes |
|---|---|---|
| Tarkeshwar and Belkot | 1 injured, 3 adults | 28 |
| Jwalamukhi | 3 elderly, 1 adult | 28 |
| Myagang, first trip | 3 children, 1 adult | 38 |
| Myagang, second trip | 3 adults | 38 |
| Kakani and Galchhi | 3 elderly, 1 adult | 90 |
| **Total driving** | **19 people** | **222** |

**Deferred people**

| Location | People deferred | Penalty |
|---|---|---|
| Likhu market | 1 adult | 20 |
| Kakani farm | 1 adult | 20 |
| Tadi farm | 2 adults | 40 |
| **Total** | **4 adults** | **80** |

**Total cost:** 222 driving minutes + 80 in penalties = 302
